ideas.pitch: An autonomous agentic workflow runner that intercepts CI/CD pipeline failures, diagnoses root causes via git diffs and logs, writes a fix, and opens a functional pull request.
ideas.title: AgentFlow-CI
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly targets the debugging pain point seen in winning projects like bobthebuilder by showing multi-file fixes and automated PR creation that judges can test immediately on a broken repo.

ideas.pitch: An enterprise knowledge graph builder that ingests internal Slack threads, PR comments, and legacy docs to create an interactive onboarding agent for new engineering hires.
ideas.title: OnboardAgent
ideas.why_it_could_win: Replicates the exact team lifecycle intelligence strategy that won first place at devflow by solving institutional knowledge loss in a way technical judges instantly appreciate.

ideas.pitch: A Model Context Protocol server integrated with local medical databases that allows autonomous AI agents to query patient records safely with role-based schema validation.
ideas.title: MCP-MedicalGate
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages the powerful architectural patterns seen in winning MCP implementations, appealing strongly to judges looking for deep systems integration over basic wrapper prompts.

ideas.pitch: A training-free semantic router that dynamically selects the most cost-effective local or hosted LLM for incoming agent tool-calls using a kNN exemplar index.
ideas.title: SemanticRoute-Eval
ideas.why_it_could_win: Adopts the self-improving semantic routing mechanism that won top prizes at the Superlinked × Qwen Hackathon by offering quantifiable cost-saving metrics.

ideas.pitch: An autonomous IT service desk agent that reads incoming email tickets, queries internal SharePoint runbooks, performs automated triage, and posts approval requests.
ideas.title: AutoITSM-Agent
ideas.why_it_could_win: Emulates the successful enterprise automation pattern from the Microsoft Agent Academy winner by targeting tedious IT workflows that eliminate SaaS overhead.
